title: release: add artifact provenance, SBOM generation, and cosign signing to private-installer release pipeline
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: Add reproducible provenance and supply-chain attestations to the Private Installer release pipeline so on-prem and VPC customers can verify published artifacts before installing. This PR integrates SBOM generation (syft), cosign-based signing of tarballs/manifests, and emits a release-manifest/provenance JSON that the installer and downstream automation can consume. Checklist: - [x] Generate SBOM for release artifacts (syft) - [x] Sign artifacts and manifest with cosign; upload signatures alongside artifacts - [x] Emit release-manifest and provenance JSON into release-manifests/private-installer/<version>/ - [x] Add CI verification step to fail on unsigned/mismatched artifacts - [x] Update docs for release signing and verification - [x] Add e2e test that verifies signature and SBOM during install What changed (summary): Added CI steps to build installer tarballs and helm chart packages, generate SBOMs using syft, sign artifacts and the release manifest with cosign using GitHub Actions, and write a machine-readable provenance artifact (predicate) compatible with our release automation. The release-manifest contains artifact urls, digests, SBOM locations, and cosign signature urls. The installer now includes an optional verification step (enabled in Dedicated/Private installs) that fetches and verifies signatures before applying Helm charts. Security notes: Keys are stored in secrets manager and accessed via GitHub Actions OIDC instead of long-lived raw secrets. We also added documentation for key rotation and cosign key provisioning for air-gapped customers. Migration notes: No breaking change for default installs. Customers who enable verification get additional integrity guarantees; upgrade path documented. Links: Linear ENG-2147 (supply-chain hardening), internal playbook: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-2147, design spec: docs/private-installer/release-signing.md
